title: Sum of neighbor averages
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $f$ be a rational-valued function on its vertices. The sum, over all vertices, of the average of $f$ over the indexed neighbors of each vertex equals the sum of $f$ over all vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The multigraph has a finite vertex set V
f maps vertices to rational numbers
